item.title: Enhanced juvenile curfew in effect this weekend for Navy Yard, U Street corridor
item.description: D.C. has once again put special curfew zones in place as officials try to get ahead of large teen gatherings this weekend.The curfews in Navy Yard and the U Street corridor went into effect at 8 p.m. on Friday and last until 11 p.m. The same goes for Saturday and Sunday. item.title: Loudoun County set to cull deer population at Claude Moore Park next week
item.description: The Loudoun County Department of Parks, Recreation and Community Services says they will soon be culling deer at Claude Moore Park. They say a deer population management operation is needed as the population has grown too large for the area. Officials say they will conduct a controlled deer cull in partnership with the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Wildlife Services. item.title: Early morning electrical fire inside bedroom wall damages Fairfax County home
item.description: An early morning house fire in Belle Haven caused an estimated $20,129 in damage. Officials say it was caused by an electrical event.
